verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Adyen terminals are PCI PTS/PCI-compliant certified and capture card data via the Terminal API, supporting reduced PCI scope for card-present integrations, but there is no explicit vendor guidance document addressing the developer's residual PCI-DSS obligations (e.g., SAQ type, cardholder-data handling responsibilities) beyond terminal certification. missing for 10: explicit documentation of remaining PCI-DSS obligations/SAQ guidance for the integrating developer, independent audit confirmation of scope reduction.
